rationale: Wind damage to the policyholder's own roof structure (shingles on porch overhang) is direct property damage to the dwelling.
claim_summary: Policyholder reports wind damage to back porch overhang, with approximately four shingles blown off. No water intrusion or secondary damage. Estimated repair cost is $400. Claim falls below the $2,500 deductible on the policy.

case_facts.description: wind blew off four shingles from overhang
